paragraphs.text: Fish is a creature type used for cards that depict any gill-bearing aquatic vertebrate animal that lacks limbs with digits. Included in this definition are Lampreys, and cartilaginous fishes like rays and mantas.
Related races are Leviathans and Merfolk .
Fish are predominantly in blue , though they occassionally appear in green , black , or red . Morska, Undersea Sleuth is the only white -aligned fish.
The first creature to bear the type Fish was Manta Ray in Weatherlight (though the Devouring Deep from Legends was later issued errata to become Fish as well).

The concept of fish-adjacent people is usually taken by Merfolk , but fishfolk as a species distinct from merfolks have been introduced in Aetherdrift , where they are part of the Keelhaulers racing team.
Creature types changed into Fish include:
Devouring Deep ( Devouring Deep )
Island Fish ( Island Fish Jasconius )
Shark ( Giant Shark ; reverted with Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths )
On Bloomburrow minnows are part of the catch of otterfolk , and Fish are commonly exchanged as gifts . There are no eels, likely because there are no oceans where they can spawn.
The Flood Gar is a calamity beast that regularly drowns entire regions.

A devouring deep was under the command of the wizard Coldraith of Golthonor . In the year 1281 by the Reckoning of the Sages of Minorad , the creature attacked people led by the Marked Cleric . Caliphear the Nightmare and Altair of Coloni forced it to reveal its master was Coldraith. The devouring deep was afraid of merfolk assassins .

Fishliver Oil was a potion given to Jared Carthalion by Grenfell Mor of Golthonor which would allow Jared to breathe underwater when he searched for the second of the two long-daggers in the Golthonor Sea .

Desert rays are sand-colored creatures that inhabit the Sukurvian Desert . They are forty feet long and are related to manta ray s. In early stories, they were used by the Sand Warriors for transportation.
On Otaria , people used the Slipstream Eel as a means of underwater transportation.
Deep in the bowls of the House swims the Lurker in the Deep .
When Emrakul was drawn to Innistrad by Nahiri , several fishermen found themselves fused to their prey, creating large abominations that roamed the sea.
The Stormwreck Sea between Ixalan and Torrezon is home to several gigantic forms of fish, like the Fleet Swallower , which is sometimes mistaken for an island.
Skyswimmer Koi swim among the clouds of Kamigawa .
The swamps of Mercadia are home to the Quagmire Lamprey .
Several fishes on Mirrodin were also airborne. Most lived near the Quicksilver Sea , but many were driven from their homes when the plane became Phyrexianized.

Jasconius are island-sized fish that have long provided shelter for smugglers’ havens and pirates’ dens. Migratory, and thus unchartable, the fish provide perfect hideouts. It is based on the Zaratan from One Thousand and One Nights , though it takes its name from a fish of the same name in the Legend of Saint Brendan .

Dandân are giant fish whose Fishliver Oil allows humans to survive underwater. They are based on the creature of the same name from One Thousand and One Nights and are the namesake of the Forgetful Fish format. In the story, they are capable of swallowing a ship whole, but extremely vulnerable, leading to the card's 4/1 stats.
The Rootwater on Rath was infested with piranhas and sharks .
Electric eels live in the sewers of Ravnica 's Undercity .(
Fish are also a favorite of the Simic in their creation of Krasis .
Kapsho Kitefins are a breed of flying fish that terrorize the people near the Kapsho Sea.
In the old timeline, the zombified remains of large anglerfish could be found in the swamps of the Sultai . These fish preyed on humans.
Fish are cultivated in the new timeline by the Ojutai clan as food for their draconic masters. Some of these can reach tremendous sizes, such as the Ancient Carp .
The Hippocampi of Theros are creatures that are half- horse and half-fish.

Many fishes of Zendikar not only live in the water but can also be found living in the sky. One example of these airborne kinds of fish is the Cloud Manta , which breeds in the ruins found across the skyscape of Zendikar and is sometimes tamed by the local merfolk as a mount. Another is the Windrider Eel , which is sometimes used as a mount by kor skyfishers.
